[0.00-3.89] Cinematic tracking shot, vertical 9:16 frame, bright campus corridor with large windows and warm sunlight. Character A, a young black man wearing a white T-shirt, black pants and white shoes, runs forward with large steps and reaches one arm forward with an urgent expression. Character A says: "嘿！微微！等等我！我想跟你学中文！" Character B, a young white woman wearing a stylish white top and a yellow plaid mini skirt with black shoes, walks quickly ahead without looking back. Character B says: "no dialogue". Natural human motion, cinematic lighting.

[3.89-7.78] Cinematic tracking shot, vertical 9:16 frame, bright campus corridor. Character B, a young white woman wearing a stylish white top and a yellow plaid mini skirt, speeds up her pace, walking away without turning her head. Character B says: "少来！你们留学生学中文，思想都不纯！" Character A, a young black man wearing a white T-shirt and black pants, follows closely behind with an eager look. Character A says: "no dialogue". Natural human motion, cinematic lighting.

[7.78-11.67] Cinematic tracking shot, vertical 9:16 frame, bright campus corridor. Character A, a young black man wearing a white T-shirt and black pants, chases closely behind, panting with an earnest expression. Character A says: "我是认真的！我听说中文是世界上最长、最深奥的语言，我想深入了解一下！" Character B, a young white woman wearing a stylish white top and a yellow plaid mini skirt, continues walking quickly. Character B says: "no dialogue". Natural human motion, cinematic lighting.

[11.67-15.56] Cinematic tracking shot, vertical 9:16 frame, bright campus corridor near a corner. Character B, a young white woman wearing a stylish white top and a yellow plaid mini skirt, blushes slightly as she turns the corner of the school building. Character B says: "嫌深啊？那你别学啊！" Character A, a young black man wearing a white T-shirt and black pants, follows around the corner. Character A says: "no dialogue". Natural human motion, cinematic lighting.

[15.56-19.44] Cinematic low-angle tracking shot, vertical 9:16 frame, campus staircase. Character A, a young black man wearing a white T-shirt and black pants, takes large strides climbing three steps at a time. Character A says: "不嫌！我听说中文有四个声调，抑扬顿挫，很有节奏感！这不正好是我的强项吗？" Character B, a young white woman wearing a stylish white top and a yellow plaid mini skirt, moves quickly up the stairs ahead. Character B says: "no dialogue". Natural human motion, cinematic lighting.

[19.44-23.33] Cinematic tracking shot, vertical 9:16 frame, bright campus corridor. Character B, a young white woman wearing a stylish white top and a yellow plaid mini skirt, starts jogging, then looks back with a playful, teasing smile. Character B says: "光有节奏感有什么用？中文讲究的是持久度！我们中国上下五千年，你才学了几天？" Character A, a young black man wearing a white T-shirt and black pants, keeps up the chase behind her. Character A says: "no dialogue". Natural human motion, cinematic lighting.

[23.33-27.22] Cinematic tracking shot, vertical 9:16 frame, bright campus corridor. Character A, a young black man wearing a white T-shirt and black pants, takes a deep breath and begins to sprint forward with determination. Character A says: "微微！你别小看我！虽然我基础薄弱，但我底子厚、爆发力强！而且我学东西……特、别、快！" Character B, a young white woman wearing a stylish white top and a yellow plaid mini skirt, continues running ahead. Character B says: "no dialogue". Natural human motion, cinematic lighting.

[27.22-31.11] Cinematic close-up shot, vertical 9:16 frame, bright campus corridor. Character B, a young white woman wearing a stylish white top and a yellow plaid mini skirt, suddenly stops, turns around quickly, crosses her arms over her chest, and looks at him with a playful, mocking expression. Character B says: "噢？特别快？" Character A, a young black man wearing a white T-shirt and black pants, halts abruptly in front of her, waving his hands in a panic. Character A says: "不不不！不是那个快！是……是效率高！" Natural human motion, cinematic lighting.

[31.11-35.00] Cinematic medium shot, vertical 9:16 frame, bright campus corridor. Character B, a young white woman wearing a stylish white top and a yellow plaid mini skirt, looks him up and down, then proudly tilts her chin up. Character B says: "行啊，想让我教你“深入”交流？——追上我再说！" Character A, a young black man wearing a white T-shirt and black pants, brightens up and smiles widely, showing his white teeth. Character A says: "嘿嘿，这可是你说的！那我可要一步到头了！" Character B turns around quickly and starts sprinting away. Character B says: "流氓！你先追到教室再说！" Natural human motion, cinematic lighting.
